counterexample.explanation: The repair tests the bit of compress(105), which is the bit of tick 100. That bit is set, so the repair leaves currentTick at 105 and the first getNext returns 105. Tick 105 is not initialized and is not a multiple of the spacing. The liquidity result is still right because tick 105 has zero net liquidity, but requirement 4 allows only initialized ticks.

summary: The repair skips the call to _advanceToNextDown whenever the bitmap bit of compress(startTick) is set. This returns an initialized aligned start tick, but for an unaligned start whose rounded-down tick is initialized it returns the unaligned start tick itself. The extra tick has zero net liquidity and the hook only writes reward growth to an unaligned tick that no position can use, so I found no new High or Medium flaw.
